description: Контр spear opener: mill → Imperial Hippodrome, Castle ~12:24. Ставить vs любого, кто может открыть казармами-копьями или Sipahi+spear (English, Ottomans, HRE, Japanese, Abbasid, Ayyubids, OOTD, Templars, mirror Byz…). Не mill vs French, Golden Horde, Jeanne, Malians, Rus, Sengoku, Delhi — там 3-stone Winery. Feudal 4:00. VOD 0pkvLN16f4o с 10:19.
name: [1x1][OPEN][BYZ][TEMPO] Valdemar: Hippodrome Mill → Castle 12 мин
author: Valdemar1902 / Valdy

notes: Снимать ВНЕШНИЕ ягоды. Если spear rush — уйти на внутренние, longbows всё равно выйдут.
Spear opener = казармы-копья в тёмной/раннем феодале. Не mill vs French / Golden Horde / Jeanne / Malians / Rus / Sengoku / Delhi.
Следующие 2 на @resource/resource_gold.webp@. Если spear rush уже виден — сразу 3 на золото.
5 с овец на @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ в 2 тайлах от ТЦ. В гайде 5, в видео из-за скорости longbow иногда 6.
@resource/rally.webp@ страглеры. Золото снять после 35g на ап копий. 6 на ягодах — масло на longbows к ~3:40.
Longbow + horseman + limitanei. Сидеть дома, рейдить конями.
8 дерева → ралли овцы до 12–14, потом 4 золото. Типично ~13/13. Не на камне — это не 2TC.
@building_military/barracks.webp@. Longbow spear дома, кони в рейд.
Стоп юнитов. Castle: 2–3 дерево, остальное еда/золото. 12 золота мало — золото нужно на переход.
Монастырь только после Hippodrome. Апы кроме horseman, если коней мало. Удар за ~минуту до апов оппонента.

map: Открытые и гибридные карты против spear-civs
strategy: Mill Hippodrome, oil longbows, sit at home, Castle 12:24
reasoning: Valdemar: mill контрит spear openers (казарма Spearmen / Ottoman Sipahi+spear на твой камень). Не mill vs French, Golden Horde, Jeanne, Malians, Rus, Sengoku, Delhi — у них другой early (рыцари, конница, eco). Feudal 4:00, Castle ~12:24, VOD с 10:19.

tactics.title: Mill vs spear openers only
tactics.detail: Spear opener = Dark/early Feudal barracks Spearmen (or Ottoman Sipahi+spear) onto your stone/gold. Mill vs English, Ottomans, HRE, Japanese, Abbasid, Ayyubids, OOTD, Templars, Byz mirror, Mongols-if-spears. Never mill vs French, Golden Horde, Jeanne, Malians, Rus, Sengoku, Delhi — those are 3-stone Winery.

tactics.title: Outer berries first, inner if rushed
tactics.detail: Place vills on the outer bush so a spear rush can fall back inside and still hit the longbow oil timing.

tactics.title: 2 gold, or 3 if spears already coming
tactics.detail: Bank 35 extra gold for the spear upgrade, then pull gold to wood.

tactics.title: Enough oil for longbows at 3:40
tactics.detail: Leave ~6 on berries during the Hippodrome. At 3:40 game time you can already afford mercenary longbows.

tactics.title: Longbow spear at home, horsemen raid
tactics.detail: Do not wander. Shivs lose to longbows. No stone = not a 2TC — stable into aggression, then Castle.

tactics.title: Must Castle around 12 minutes
tactics.detail: Hippodrome has no monastery — drop it in Castle. Two stables, cataphracts, upgrades, hit ~1 min before their upgrades.

transcriptText:
[10:19] Winery triple-stone is the default. Mill opener when Sipahi-spear / spear rush is possible.
[10:48] Spear rush already coming → 3 on gold now; otherwise 2 on gold.
[11:02] Mill up. Two on gold, rally sheep until Feudal.
[11:32] Outer berries so you can fall inside if speared and still get longbows.
[12:23] Then Hippodrome, longbow + horseman + limitanei. Extra 35 gold for spear upgrade.
[12:44] Age up with ~6 (video) / 5 (written BO) because longbows come out so fast.
[13:06] Hippodrome two tiles from TC, rally wood, 8 wood like the Winery opener, keep 6 on berries for oil.
[14:05] At 3:40 you have enough oil for longbows.
[14:33] Market. No stone = new stable opener, not 2TC.
[15:24] Sit at home with longbow spear, raid with horsemen. ~13 gold / 13 food.
[21:17] Age up around 12 minutes or you get punished.
[23:35] No monastery on Hippodrome — drop it in Castle.
[25:07] Timing attack ~1 minute before their upgrades land.
[25:46] Meta: Castle ~12, upgrade, hit. Mill BO is in the description.
